newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Erste to bid for Creditanstalt again.
newsitem.headline: Erste to bid for Creditanstalt again.

text.p: Austrian savings bank Die Erste said on Wednesday it would team up for a second time with a consortium led by insurer EA-Generali to submit a bid for privatisation candidate Creditanstalt.
The bank's widely expected announcement came after a meeting of Die Erste's board of governors.
The latest tender for the government's 70 percent voting stake in Creditanstalt, the flagship of the Austrian banking system, closes on Friday.

Die Erste orginally left the Italo-Austrian-German consortium on September 6 following disagreement over the form their bid should take. The group, which includes Germany's Commerzbank and Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana, on Monday voted in favour of Die Erste's return.
Austrian media have reported only nine parties have asked for the government's information memorandum on which they could base a potential bid.

The government has been trying to sell its 19.9 million shares in the bank for over six years now. Finance Minister Viktor Klima has said he is confident the privatisation could be wrapped up before the end of the year. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
